senses.gloss: kruñcati = kroñcati, krauñcayati; see s.v. 2 krauñca.

[kruhi, Mv 〔i.280.14〕 and 〔ii.405.15〕, so Senart with mss.; but read brūmi in both. Note that mss. at 〔ii.405.15〕 point to (a)ham as subject. In a number of other places the Mv mss. read kruhi or krumi (〔ii.50.2, 12〕; 〔51.2, 12〕; 〔52.2〕; 〔181.16〕; 〔193.10〕; 〔256.15〕; 〔294.13〕; 〔482.12〕; 〔iii.17.18〕; 〔214.4〕), but Senart always em. brūhi or brūmi; also in 〔i.307.1〕 mss. krutha, Senart em. brutha, intending brūtha. Sometimes a corresponding Pali passage proves the emendation right, e.g. Mv 〔iii.214.4〕 = DN 〔ii.242.16〕 brūhi; Mv 〔ii.50.2〕 = Jāt. 〔v.387.21〕 vadāmi (Mv brūmi). In my opinion Senart should have made a clean sweep of these erroneous forms and adopted brūmi in 〔i.280.14〕 and 〔ii.405.15〕.]
